**Implementation note:** Bulk-classified VPIN from bars; disputed evidence.

## Description

Estimates volume-synchronized buy/sell imbalance to identify order flow that may be adverse for passive liquidity providers.

## Where it may fit

Short-horizon markets when informed-flow risk and volatility spikes matter to a maker or execution algorithm.

## Vehicles

Electronic market making, HFT, execution risk controls and futures trading.

## Required data

Trade prints classified by buyer/seller initiation, volume buckets, trade intensity and time-synchronized quotes.

## Caveats

VPIN's predictive value is debated and sensitive to trade classification; use as one risk feature, not a stand-alone guarantee of toxic flow.
